findings.title: A presentation finding that calls a claim unsupported while citing a SUPPORTED fact whose value is verbatim in its own quote is the reviewer's own defect - and this one made the repair stage delete a true, fact-backed sentence
findings.detail: The first review of this draw blocked on F08: criterion 'presentation', section quick_start, quote 'using Aspose_PDF_FOSS version 1.0.0.', fact_ids ['example:001', 'package:version'], text 'The candidate adds \u2018version 1.0.0\u2019 to the Quick Start description but the facts do not support a versioned claim', repair 'Remove \u2018version 1.0.0\u2019'. facts.json records package:name = 'Aspose_PDF_FOSS' and package:version = '1.0.0', both SUPPORTED; the S3 investigation's own product_summary cites package:version as its evidence. The finding therefore names, as its own evidence, the fact that verifies the sentence it calls unverified. No guard caught it: factuality_defect judges criterion 'factuality' only, absence_defect needs an 'absent' list (this one is empty), and a8ac6d4's _quoted_verified_fact folds a quote that references a SUPPORTED public_symbol - package facts are a different kind. The repair round obeyed: repairs.json attempt 65d25781 rewrote the unit from '...at 150 DPI using Aspose_PDF_FOSS version 1.0.0.' to '...using Aspose_PDF_FOSS.'. A true, fact-backed detail was removed from a public candidate because a finding said the opposite of its own citation. Fix, mirroring a8ac6d4 one kind wider: a presentation/factuality finding whose quote contains the literal value of a SUPPORTED fact it cites is a reviewer scope defect. Mutation test: this finding and these facts - red (blocks, repair fires) before, green (advisory) after. Alternative rejected: widening _quoted_verified_fact to every fact kind by suffix match, which would refold quotes by coincidental word overlap - the collision a8ac6d4 was written to stop.
findings.evidence: review.json (first read of draw 3, findings[0] = F08); facts.json package:version; repairs.json attempt 65d25781acc333146baa1261 changes R01.

findings.title: A finding whose refuted claims are the ones its repair instruction names is unactionable: the reviewer faulted the candidate for omitting the exact sentence the previous repair round had just inserted at BC-08's demand
findings.detail: Order of events inside this one transaction, from the ledger and repairs.json. (1) BC-08 FAILED: inherited_unit:019.paragraph is VERIFIED_PRESERVE and keeps the command 'cmake --preset windows-msvc-debug', but the candidate did not render it. (2) targeted_repair attempt 1c50ad99 repaired exactly that, appending 'The build instructions include the command cmake --preset windows-msvc-debug.' to the development_testing unit. (3) The final review then raised F10 on section development_testing, text 'The development and testing section omits the CMake preset instructions and the test suite coverage details', repair 'Restore the CMake preset instructions and the test suite coverage details' - and its quote is that repaired sentence, character for character. Replayed offline through the production functions: of F10's five 'absent' claims, three ('cmake --preset windows-msvc-debug', '976 test files', 'foundation primitives') are located in its own section slice and two ('src/public/', 'src/internal/') are genuinely absent and present in the evidence. absence_defect therefore returns None - correctly, under the 2026-09-07 rule that one unrefuted claim leaves a real remainder - and the whole finding blocks. The defect is not that rule; it is that the finding's prose, quote and repair instruction all name the refuted claims while the remainder is two strings none of them mentions, so the repair round is handed an instruction whose work is already done and the equivalent failure re-raises. Fix: narrow rather than dismiss. Record the refuted claims on the finding and hand targeted_repair only the surviving ones, so the repair asks for 'src/public/' and 'src/internal/' or the finding carries no actionable claim at all. Mutation test: this finding, this candidate - red (repair told to restore text already present) before, green (repair sees only the two surviving claims) after. Alternative rejected: reverting to whole-finding dismissal, which the 2026-09-07 external review already proved loses real gaps.
findings.evidence: review.json findings F10; repairs.json attempt 1c50ad9934884512ae25c61b; validation.json BC-08 failure detail; offline replay of absence_defect/scope_defect over the run's own artifacts.
